vars.--gradient-spark: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--gold) 60%, transparent), transparent 60%)

keyframes.name: spark
keyframes.css: @keyframes spark { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; transform: translateY(0); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-2px); } }

keyframes.name: ticker
keyframes.css: @keyframes ticker { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

keyframes.name: rise
keyframes.css: @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

keyframes.name: bolt-strike
keyframes.css: @keyframes bolt-strike { 0%, 50% { stroke-dashoffset: 240; opacity: 0; } 52% { stroke-dashoffset: 240; opacity: 1; } 58% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 1; } 62% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0.9; } 66% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0; } }

keyframes.name: node-pulse
keyframes.css: @keyframes node-pulse { 0%, 54% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } 58% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.6); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } 66% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } 72%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } }
